title: Eikonal, nonlocality and regular black holes
summary: We investigate the leading gravitational eikonal in nonlocal $D$ dimensional theories of gravity. We analyze the simplest cases of $2\rightarrow2$ massless and massive scalar scattering at tree level, studying the effects of nonlocal form factors in the gravitational sector. We give an interpretation of our results in terms of geodesic motion in effective generalized Aichelburg-Sexl geometries for the massless case, and in smeared linearized Schwarzschild metrics for the massive case in the probe limit.
